A '''detainment moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that was used to house anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] individuals and other criminals.

==History==
The detainment [[Moon/Legends|moons]] were established in the crackdown of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The relocation of detainees was carried out through the use of massive [[Imperial prison barge]]s, essentially mobile [[Prison/Legends|prisons]]&mdash;complete with guards and wardens&mdash;that traveled throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One detainment moon was [[Gradient Seven]].
